brief:
Channel 15 reported that Hezbollah is attempting to draw Iran into responding should the Israeli military destroy the Ali al-Tahir hills, the Ma'an Wire reported. Israel faces calls not to withdraw or repeat what the report characterizes as the error of limiting strikes to Beirut while Tehran retaliates northward.

The report frames a deterrence equation centered on continued destruction of infrastructure, stating that any party opening fire will receive a stronger strike in return. The assessment suggests Hezbollah is seeking to expand the scope of potential Iranian involvement in any escalation.
